_note: PS60 plays. pivot = the 60-minute pivot (Dan's word; the old trigger key still works). second_entry (optional, leave it out until the pivot breaks) = the new high (long) / new low (short) after the break; the entry is back through it after the retrace. TWINEY finds it for you and offers 'use X as 2nd entry'. target = where the runner exits. stop = max pain. mp = your measured potential ($) and atr = the ATR ($), read off your chart. extra_levels = more prices to watch for reloads.
